title: test_protocol_vector_security.py:361-363 red on main: authenticated_schc_dio root binding check still uses native _addr_for_key
description: Pre-existing failure found while fixing nwm8 (python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py, 2026-09-09 main). test_authenticated_schc_dio_construction_has_independent_security_checks asserts dio[8:24] == _addr_for_key(public_key) where _addr_for_key (file:48) is the REJECTED SHA-512 native profile (0x02 || digest[:7] || masked digest[:8]). The authenticated_schc_dio.json corpus DODAGIDs no longer match it (root_binding False while vector expects admitted=True), so the test is red on main. Fix shape identical to nwm8: flip the check to reference_schnorr48.upstream_addr_for_key(public_key) (or verify which side drifted first — if the corpus itself still carries native addresses, fix the corpus generator instead and keep the check upstream). Same disease class as the rpl_messages.json residual fixed in nwm8.
